title: Fully Insured
question: Who owned the pie dish and why?

meanings.usage: 常用insure sth against...结构，表示为某物投保某种险
指投保人定期支付给保险公司的费用
作名词时指索赔行为；作动词时常用make a claim结构
指从灾难或水中救出财物
通常指船或类似容器的翻转
一种用电力或人力驱动的起重设备
作名词指固定用的工具；作动词指用夹子固定
指处于不稳定或高高在上的位置
指因不平衡而倒下或翻转
强调规模或程度非常大
sink的过去分词作形容词，描述沉入水中的物体
指户外的庆祝活动，通常有各种游戏和义卖

phrases.usage: 愿意做某事，表示乐意或准备做某事

examples.en: Insurance companies are normally willing to insure anything.
examples.zh: 保险公司通常愿意为任何东西保险。

phrases.usage: 如果；万一；倘若，用于引出假设的灾难情况

examples.en: It would be possible to insure yourself in the event of bad weather.
examples.zh: 如果遇到坏天气，你也可以为自己投保。

phrases.usage: 提出索赔，向保险公司要求赔偿

examples.en: A shipping company has made a claim for the cost of salvaging.
examples.zh: 一家航运公司提出了打捞费用的索赔。

examples.en: A local authority to recover the cost of salvaging.
examples.zh: 地方当局为收回打捞费用。

examples.en: The teenagers looked on while three men dived into the water.
examples.zh: 当三个人反复潜水时，青少年们在一旁观看。

examples.en: A powerful winch was put into operation.
examples.zh: 一台大功率绞车被启动运转。

examples.en: It set up a huge wave in the canal.
examples.zh: 它在运河里掀起了一股巨浪。

examples.en: It was almost impossible to attach hawsers to the rim.
examples.zh: 几乎不可能把缆绳系在边缘上。

examples.en: By working at tremendous speed, the men got the dish on to dry land.
examples.zh: 由于以极快的速度工作，这些人把盘子弄到了陆地上。

examples.en: The men were now obliged to try once more.
examples.zh: 这些人现在不得不再次尝试。

sentences.en: Insurance companies are normally willing to insure anything.
sentences.zh: 保险公司通常愿意为任何东西投保。

sentences.en: Insuring public or private property is a standard practice in most countries in the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界上大多数国家，为公共或私人财产投保是一种惯例。

sentences.en: If, however, you were holding an open air garden party or a fete it would be equally possible to insure yourself in the event of bad weather.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你要举办一场露天花园派对或游园会，同样可以为自己投保，以防恶劣天气。

sentences.en: Needless to say, the bigger the risk an insurance company takes, the higher the premium you will have to pay.
sentences.zh: 不言而喻，保险公司承担的风险越大，你将支付的保费就越高。

sentences.en: It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim for the cost of salvaging a sunken ship.
sentences.zh: 航运公司为打捞沉船的费用提出索赔并非罕见。

sentences.en: But the claim made by a local authority to recover the cost of salvaging a sunken pie dish must surely be unique.
sentences.zh: 但地方当局为打捞沉没的馅饼盘而提出的索赔，肯定是非同寻常的。

sentences.en: Admittedly it was an unusual pie dish, for it was eighteen feet long and six feet wide.
sentences.zh: 诚然，这是一个不寻常的馅饼盘，因为它有18英尺长，6英尺宽。

sentences.en: It had been purchased by a local authority so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair.
sentences.zh: 它是由地方当局购买的，以便为一年一度的集市烤制一个巨大的馅饼。

sentences.en: The pie committee decided that the best way to transport the dish would be by canal so they insured it for the trip.
sentences.zh: 馅饼委员会决定，运输这个盘子的最好方式是水路，所以他们为这次行程投了保。

sentences.en: Shortly after it was launched, the pie committee went to a local inn to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 盘子下水后不久，馅饼委员会就去了一家当地的旅店庆祝。

sentences.en: At the same time, a number of teenagers climbed on to the dish and held a little party of their own.
sentences.zh: 同时，一些青少年爬上盘子，开起了他们自己的小型派对。

sentences.en: Dancing proved to be more than the dish could bear,
sentences.zh: 跳舞对盘子来说是无法承受的，

sentences.en: for during the party it capsized and sank in seven feet of water.
sentences.zh: 因为在派对期间，它翻了船，沉入了七英尺深的水中。

sentences.en: The pie committee telephoned a local garage owner who arrived in a recovery truck to salvage the pie dish.
sentences.zh: 馅饼委员会给当地的一位修车厂老板打电话，他开着一辆救援卡车前来打捞馅饼盘。

sentences.en: Shivering in their wet clothes, the teenagers looked on while three men dived repeatedly into the water to locate the dish.
sentences.zh: 少年们穿着湿衣服颤抖着，看着三名男子反复潜入水中寻找盘子。

sentences.en: They had little difficulty in finding it, but hauling it out of the water proved to be a serious problem.
sentences.zh: 他们找到它几乎没什么困难，但把它从水中拖出来却是个大问题。

sentences.en: The sides of the dish were so smooth that it was almost impossible to attach hawsers and chains to the rim without damaging it.
sentences.zh: 盘子的侧面非常光滑，几乎不可能在不损坏它的情况下将缆绳和链条固定到边缘。

sentences.en: Eventually chains were fixed to one end of the dish and a powerful winch was put into operation.
sentences.zh: 最终，链条被固定在盘子的一端，一台强大的绞车开始工作。

sentences.en: The dish rose to the surface and was gently drawn towards the canal bank.
sentences.zh: 盘子浮出水面，被轻轻地拉向运河岸边。

sentences.en: For one agonizing moment, the dish was perched precariously on the bank of the canal,
sentences.zh: 有一刻，盘子摇摇晃晃地栖息在运河岸边，令人心焦，

sentences.en: but it suddenly overbalanced and slid back into the water.
sentences.zh: 但它突然失去平衡，滑回了水中。

sentences.en: The men were now obliged to try once more.
sentences.zh: 男人们现在不得不再次尝试。

sentences.en: This time they fixed heavy metal clamps to both sides of the dish so that they could fasten the chains.
sentences.zh: 这次他们在盘子的两边固定了沉重的金属夹，以便系上链条。

sentences.en: The dish now had to be lifted vertically because one edge was resting against the side of the canal.
sentences.zh: 盘子现在必须垂直吊起，因为一侧正抵着运河的侧面。

sentences.en: The winch was again put into operation and one of the men started up the truck.
sentences.zh: 绞车再次启动，其中一名男子发动了卡车。

sentences.en: Several minutes later, the dish was successfully hauled above the surface of the water.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，盘子被成功地吊出水面。

sentences.en: Water streamed in torrents over its sides with such force that it set up a huge wave in the canal.
sentences.zh: 水从盘子两侧倾泻而下，力量之大，以至于在运河中掀起了巨浪。

sentences.en: There was a danger that the wave would rebound off the other side of the bank and send the dish plunging into the water again.
sentences.zh: 存在着波浪会从运河对岸反弹回来，再次将盘子冲入水中的危险。

sentences.en: By working at tremendous speed, the men managed to get the dish on to dry land before the wave returned.
sentences.zh: 男人们以惊人的速度工作，在波浪返回之前设法将盘子弄上了岸。

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.definition: 当句子的主语是动作的承受者时，使用被动语态。被动语态由be动词+过去分词构成。
grammar.structure: 主语 + be + 过去分词 (+ by + 动作执行者)
grammar.usage: 当不知道动作执行者、强调动作承受者或上下文中不需要提及执行者时使用被动语态。

examples.en: The pie dish was insured for the trip.
examples.zh: 这个馅饼盘被投保了旅途险。

examples.en: The dish was raised to the surface and was drawn towards the canal bank.
examples.zh: 盘子被升到水面并被拖向运河岸边。

grammar.title: It is + not uncommon / not unusual to... (it作形式主语)
grammar.definition: it作形式主语代替不定式短语或从句，真正的主语是后面的不定式to结构。这种结构用于表达某种情况并不罕见。
grammar.structure: It is + not uncommon / not unusual + to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用来表达某事经常发生或并不稀奇，语气较委婉。

examples.en: It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim.
examples.zh: 听到航运公司提出索赔是很常见的。

examples.en: It is not unusual to see tourists here in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天这里有游客并不稀奇。

grammar.title: more than + n./adj. (不仅仅；超出)
grammar.definition: more than可以修饰名词、形容词或动词，表示程度'超出'或'不仅仅'的含义。
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词 + more than + 名词/形容词/动词
grammar.usage: 用于强调数量、程度或性质超出预期或某个界限。

examples.en: Dancing proved to be more than the dish could bear.
examples.zh: 跳舞被证明是这只盘子承受不了的。

examples.en: This is more than I can afford.
examples.zh: 这超出了我的能力范围。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词 + for + 目的

original.en: The pie committee decided that the best way to transport the dish would be by canal so they insured it for the trip.
original.zh: 馅饼委员会决定运输这只盘子的最好方式是通过运河，所以他们为旅途投了保。

examples.en: The company insured the equipment for the experiment.
examples.zh: 公司为实验设备投了保。

examples.en: He insured his car for the journey.
examples.zh: 他为旅途中的汽车投保了。

patterns.pattern: It is + adj. + to + 动词原形

original.en: It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim.
original.zh: 听到航运公司提出索赔是很常见的。

examples.en: It is not unusual to see children playing in the park.
examples.zh: 看到孩子们在公园里玩耍并不稀奇。

examples.en: It is essential to understand the importance of insurance.
examples.zh: 理解保险的重要性是必要的。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/had little difficulty in + doing sth

original.en: They had little difficulty in finding it.
original.zh: 他们找到它没什么困难。

examples.en: I had little difficulty in solving this problem.
examples.zh: 我解决这个难题没费什么力气。

examples.en: She had little difficulty in passing the exam.
examples.zh: 她通过考试没费什么力气。

patterns.pattern: be + adj. + enough + to + 动词原形

original.en: The dish rose to the surface and was gently drawn towards the canal bank.
original.zh: 盘子升到水面并被轻轻地拖向运河岸边。

examples.en: The bridge was strong enough to support the weight.
examples.zh: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受这个重量。

examples.en: He was tall enough to reach the shelf.
examples.zh: 他足够高，能够到那个架子。
